# Model comparison (generated by scripts/render_model_comparison.py)

All models evaluated on all 31,509 cases. Column `log`: C = completion projection (24 labels), A = abstracted log (17 labels, [event abstraction](../../docs/EVENT_ABSTRACTION.md)); C and A values are not directly comparable, see [common-log comparison](../abstraction/comparison.csv). `n/c` = not computable (finite-state metric on an unbounded net). `(certified)` = exact-replay ceiling or dead-transition count from exact rational certificates, not from replay.
